EPS is set to inch up just 0.5% annually, well below the market’s 15.6%. The company’s net profit margin climbed to 30.2% from last year’s 22.9%. Over the past year, earnings growth reached 70.3%, outpacing the company’s five-year average and highlighting a significant rise in profitability in the most recent period.
